purpose: Freeze five relaxed owner-installed microcoax corridors, removable tape saddles and connector/antenna inspection access before copper routing starts.

coordinate_system.origin: upper-left board corner in the shared H1/H6 assembly view

ebyte_drawing.title: E01-ML01SP4 product specification, revision 1.9, chapter 3
ebyte_drawing.finding: The drawing fixes IPEX at the lower-left corner in top view (pad 9 side), opposite the eight digital pads, but does not dimension its centre. The chosen conservative 5 x 5 mm local corner envelope x[-7.25,-2.25], y[4,9] is transformed with the native B.Cu reflection and footprint rotation. Reach is checked to its farthest point, never an invented exact axis.

s3_module_outline.finding: The 18 x 19.2 mm module has an L-shaped planar shield, 3.2 +/- 0.15 mm total height. Its connector axis is 3 mm from the right body edge and 2.46 mm from the top, local [6,-7.14] about the footprint anchor. Native B.Fab circles confirm [31,23.615] after the B.Cu Y reflection. The selected central shield landing excludes the connector notch, rim and castellated edges.

c5_module_outline.finding: The 18 x 21.2 mm module connector axis is 3 mm from the right body edge and 2.38 mm below the top: footprint-local [6,-8.22]. Apply B.Cu reflection and native footprint rotation before checking cable reach.

board_connector_datum.basis: Hirose EDC3-302540-01 centres the coaxial mating axis on the 2.6 x 2.6 mm body. Native footprint anchor is that body centre; its asymmetric courtyard centre is displaced by 0.375 mm and must not be used as the mating axis.

common_constraints.bend_radius_evidence: H6 conservative design target, not a manufacturer minimum; received-cable dry fit and strain behaviour remain H7/H8 physical evidence

retention_saddle.method: one removable polyimide-tape bridge per cable over solder mask, or the explicitly documented S3 shield landing; no glue, tie or clamp on either plug
retention_saddle.installation_rule: mate both ends vertically first, form a visible relaxed bow, then apply the bridge without flattening the cable

enclosure_clearance.rule: no enclosure rib, pilot, stop, adhesive or loose hardware may enter a cable corridor or either connector inspection cylinder
enclosure_clearance.closed_sandwich_rule: the RF PCB and enclosure may not press a cable; exact opposed-body clearance is rechecked from the assembled STEP in H6.0.7

retention_support.evidence: s3_module_outline, Figure 10-2; safe central subset of planar shield excluding its U.FL notch
retention_support.installation_rule: apply a removable 5 x 3 mm polyimide bridge only to the shield top; keep both connector inspection circles and the shield rim clear; preserve the relaxed bow above the shield edge
retention_support.validation_boundary: planar radius and conservative two-end height-transition budget are checked; combined three-dimensional forming and opposing-body clearance remain assembled STEP/dry-fit evidence

paths.source_exit: from the actual lower-right connector of the same S3 module shifted 0.50 mm left, gently across its flat shield toward the B0 board U.FL in the gap between the first two 14.7-mm-pitch SMA ports; the solder-access candidate preserves the R3 inspection circle, 30-mm cable, at least 5-mm conservative relaxed reserve and unchanged R7 two-end Z-transition allowance

antenna_solder_inspection.rule: both edge-soldered ground tabs and the centre launch remain optically visible before enclosure closure; no top-wall lip or adhesive covers the fillets

owner_assembly: with both PCBAs open and unpowered, verify centre continuity, shield continuity and centre-to-shield isolation on every loose jumper
mate each plug straight down by its metal cap; never push, pull or unmate by the cable
route every jumper inside its named corridor, retain at least 5 mm of visible non-taut reserve and apply its single removable tape saddle
inspect all ten microcoax mates and all ten two-sided SMA solder windows before seating the four stops and mating M1 in parallel
close the sandwich only after confirming that no cable crosses M1, a stop, a screw axis, the display slot or the ZIF latch
